learning_outcomes.text: Students will observe the application of chemical engineering in the laboratory and working life, and learn to transfer theoretical knowledge provided in the training program to practice.
They will enrich their perspectives by becoming aware of the chemical engineering profession, its duties and responsibilities.
They will develop themselves in social issues such as professional ethics, human health, occupational safety, and environment.
They will learn the importance of R&D for our country and the world.
They will learn the importance of work discipline, teamwork, interdisciplinary cooperation, individual competencies, and human relations in businesses, work, and professional life.
They will develop verbal and written communication skills and understand the importance of computer and foreign language knowledge.
They will learn about quality in the laboratory, analytical devices, sampling, sample preparation and analysis, experimental methods, and standardization.
They will have the opportunity to observe contemporary techniques and developments.
